subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Books are really our best friends as we can rely on them (a) ⎯⎯ we are bored, upset, depressed, lonely or annoyed. They share with us information (b) ⎯⎯ knowledge any time we need. They enable us to have a glimpse of cultures, traditions, arts, history, geography, health, psychology (c) ⎯⎯ many other subjects and aspects of life. Good books always guide us to path of life (d) ⎯⎯ is right. Reading good books helps us to understand the world better. (e) ⎯⎯ reading books, we build new and creative thoughts, images and opinions in our mind.
guide_solution: (a) when (b) and/as well as (c) and (d) which/that (e) By
